decisions.statement: The whole deploy is one bash script assembled before anything runs on the mac.
The mac build lock is taken before the checkout runs.
The mac build lock is removed on the way out however the run ends.
A run dying at the archive leaves no lock directory for the next run to judge.
The ipa is gated on carrying the cut commit before the ipa is uploaded.
The export options plist is written by a heredoc inside the script.
A no-upload run validates the ipa where a real run would upload the ipa.
A no-upload run reaches no reserving step.
A no-upload run spends no build number.
The build number is reserved only after altool has uploaded the ipa.
The upload-ok marker is emitted before the reserving step.
The reserving step runs inside the mac build mutex.

definition: the bash script a mac runs to archive an ios app and upload it to testflight
